section: Hero: three columns with the title and intro, the main photograph, and a second photograph above a coral stat
fields: Title (the page title at the top of the editor)
Case study box, below the title: Client name
Case study box: Live site URL
Case study box: Hero stat and Hero stat caption
Case study box: Hero secondary image
notes: The small line above the title lists the Service areas that are ticked.
Title highlight is the part of the title shown in coral. Type it exactly as it appears in the title, for example 87% Increase.
The Intro is the short standfirst under the title.
The Featured image is the large photograph in the middle. The Hero secondary image sits above the coral stat. If both the secondary image and the stat are empty the third column is left out.
The Live site URL adds a card with the client name and a Live site button that opens in a new tab. The client name is also shown on case study cards as "PRJ - client name".

section: Article: the case study text beside a sticky sidebar
fields: The main editor (the case study text)
Add block, then Crucible blocks: Stat
notes: A good shape is The challenge, What we did and The result, with short paragraphs and lists.
The Stat block shows one to three big figures. It is a good way to prove the result in the middle of the story.

section: Sidebar: the timeline form and the client quote
notes: The form is the same on every case study.
Choosing a Testimonial shows its quote, the person's name, their company and their photograph or logo under the form. Without one only the form is shown.
Testimonials are added under Testimonials in the menu.

section: Closing image band: a photograph the full width of the page
fields: The main editor: the last block, an Image block
notes: If the very last block of the text is an Image block, it is lifted out of the column and shown edge to edge under the article. Leave it out if you do not want a band.

section: Related projects: two case study cards
fields: Service areas and Sectors (boxes beside the editor)
notes: The first two Related projects that you choose are shown. If you choose fewer, the latest case studies in the same Service area fill the gap.
Sectors tag the project for the filters on the Case studies page.
The dark "Interested in working with us?" band is a shared pattern and is the same on every case study.
